brief: From the creator's manager: Maya (lifestyle creator, ~240k on TikTok, 90k on YouTube) just signed a sponsorship with a fictional oat-milk brand, Oatfield. Deal is 2 TikToks, 1 YouTube integration (60-90 sec inside a regular vlog) and 3 Instagram stories with a swipe-up link. Brand wants the first TikTok live by 2026-12-01 and needs to approve scripts before filming. They sent a brand guidelines PDF but no talking points yet. Usage rights and whether we need the paid-partnership label on stories aren't clear in the contract. Maya is travelling Nov 20-24 so no filming then.

plan.summary: Produce a TikTok live, YouTube integration, and Instagram stories for lifestyle creator Maya, requiring script approval before her November travel dates. Key risks include missing talking points and unclear contract terms regarding usage rights and partnership labels.
